The **Western Revolver** is a non-automatic pistol in *Fallout 76*.

A double-action revolver chambered for the .44 Round. It has higher base damage than the standard .44 Pistol, a cleaner appearance, but is less modifiable. It also has a different grip from the standard .44 Pistol.
